children: Chemours posted an investor presentation highlighting Q2 2026 results with $1.59B net sales and $247M of adjusted EBITDA.
Posted September 2026 investor presentation for upcoming investor and analyst meetings; furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Q2 2026: Net sales $1,591M and Adjusted EBITDA $247M; free cash flow $114M and FCF conversion 46%.
Net leverage declined to 4.4x after €230M term loan repayment; liquidity $1.6B and total liquidity $671M cash + revolver capacity.
Strategic priorities: Pathway to Thrive cost savings >$250M target, portfolio shift to high-value AI/data center end markets and Opteon™ growth.
Reported progress resolving legacy liabilities including EPA/WVDEP settlement ($22.5M penalty + $90M mitigation) and NJ settlement actions.
